title: cfDNA Sequencing from Blood Samples
author: Krause Merlin
materials: Keeping the tubes on ice, add 0.9 µL, NEBNext Thermolabile Proteinase K directly to each of the repaired reaction mixtures.
Gently open the SpotON sample port.
Open the MinKnow-Software and click on "Start". Go to "Flow Cell Check" and choose the position of your Flowcell and click "Start".
Open the MinKnow-Software and click on "Start". Go to "Flow Cell Check" and choose the position of your Flowcell and click "Start".

steps.title: Blood Collection and Plasma Separation
steps.instruction: Collect blood and isolate plasma through sequential centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Draw approximately 10 mL of patient blood into two 10 mL Streck Cell-Free DNA BCT tubes.
Centrifuge at 1900 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Distribute the supernatant into 2 ml Reaction tubes.
Centrifuge the plasma at 16000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Collect the supernatant of each sample into one 15 ml tube.
Optional: Spin down for 30 seconds at 200 x g in a swing out rotor centrifuge at room temperature to remove solution from the cap.

steps.title: cfDNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Isolate cfDNA using magnetic beads and a QIAamp UCP MinElute column.

substeps.instruction: To 1 ml Plasma, add 30 µL Magnetic Bead Suspension, 55 µL Proteinase K, and 150 µL Bead Binding Buffer (Total 1235 µL).
Place tube into a magnetic rack for 2 minutes or until the supernatant is clear, then discard the supernatant.
Remove from magnetic rack and resuspend beads in 200 µL Bead Elution Buffer; pipette mix to rinse beads from the wall.
Transfer the whole mixture into a 2 ml Bead Elution Tube.
Incubate the Bead Elution Tube for 5 minutes on a tube rotator mixer (Hula mixer) at room temperature.
Place the Bead Elution Tube on a magnetic rack for ≥ 1 minute until the solution is clear.
Transfer the supernatant containing cfDNA into a new Bead Elution tube and discard the bead pellet.
Add 300 µL ACB Buffer to the Bead Elution tube, vortex to mix, and briefly centrifuge to remove drops from the lid.
Pipet the supernatant–ACB-Buffer mixture into a QIAamp UCP MinElute column.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 6,000 x g at room temperature.
Place the column into a clean 2 ml collection tube and discard the flow-through.
Add 500 µL ACW2-Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 1 minute at 6000 x g at room temperature.
Place the column into a clean 2 ml collection tube and discard the flow-through.
Centrifuge the column at 20,000 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Place the column into a new 1.5 ml elution tube and discard the 2 ml collection tube.
Open the lid and incubate the assembly in a shaker for microcentrifuge tubes at 56 °C for 3 minutes to dry the membrane completely.
Carefully pipet 23 µL ultra-clean water into the center of the membrane, close the lid, and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Centrifuge at 20,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature to elute the DNA.
To maximize yield: Aspirate the eluate, reload it onto the center of the membrane, close the lid, and incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
Centrifuge again at 20,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Initial DNA Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify the eluted cfDNA using a Qubit fluorometer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of eluted sample to 199 µL Qubit-Solution into a Qubit-Tube and quantify.

steps.title: DNA Repair
steps.instruction: Perform DNA repair on the eluted cfDNA.

substeps.instruction: In 0.2 ml thin-walled PCR tubes, mix 20 µL cfDNA (from elution), 3 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Buffer v2, and 0.9 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Mix v2 (Total 23.9 µL). Do not normalize with nuclease-free water.
Mix by gently pipetting and briefly spinning down.
Incubate in a thermal cycler (heated lid 50 °C) at 37 °C for 15 minutes, then hold at 4 °C.
Remove from thermal cycler and place on ice.
Mix by pipetting 10 times and spin down quickly.
Incubate in a thermal cycler (heated lid 75 °C) at 37 °C for 15 minutes and 65 °C for 5 minutes, then hold at 4 °C.
Remove from thermal cycler and place on ice.

steps.title: End Prep
steps.instruction: Perform end-repair and A-tailing of the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Keeping the tube on ice, add 1.3 µL NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix to the reaction (Total volume 26.1 µL).
Mix by pipetting 10 times and spin down quickly.
Incubate in a thermal cycler (heated lid 75 °C) at 20 °C for 30 minutes and 65 °C for 30 minutes, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: End-Prep Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the end-prepped DNA using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure XP Beads (AXP) by vortexing.
Add 80 µL resuspended AXP beads to each reaction and mix by flicking.
Incubate on a Hula mixer for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare 5 mL of 80% fresh ethanol in nuclease-free water.
Spin down and pellet on a magnet until the supernatant is clear and colorless; pipette off the supernatant.
Wash beads with 200 µL 80% Ethanol without disturbing the pellet; remove and discard ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash step.
Spin down, place on magnet, and pipette off residual ethanol. Dry for 30 seconds (do not crack the pellet).
Resuspend the pellet in 10 µL nuclease-free water by flicking.
Pellet the beads on a magnet for at least 1 minute until the eluate is clear and colorless.
Remove and retain 10 µL eluate into a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Quantify 1 µL of eluted sample using a Qubit fluorometer (as per initial quantification step).

steps.title: Sample Barcoding
steps.instruction: Ligate native barcodes to the DNA fragments.

substeps.instruction: Thaw EDTA at room temperature, vortex, spin down, and place on ice.
Thaw Native Barcodes (NB01-24) at room temperature, spin down, mix by pipetting, and place on ice.
Select a unique barcode for each sample. Ensure total DNA for one GridION Flowcell is between 500 ng and 1000 ng (total DNA ≤ 430 ng to not exceed 2000 fmol for 350 bp fragments).
In 0.2 ml PCR tubes, add: 7.5 µL End-prepped DNA, 2.5 µL Native Barcode, and 10 µL Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix (Total 20 µL). Do not normalize with nuclease-free water.
Mix by gently pipetting and briefly spinning down.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Add EDTA to each well: 2 µL for clear cap EDTA or 4 µL for blue cap EDTA; mix by pipetting and spin down.

steps.title: Pooled Library Cleanup
steps.instruction: Pool barcoded samples and perform a final bead cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Pool all barcoded samples into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Resuspend AMPure XP Beads (AXP) by vortexing.
Add 1.2X volume of AXP beads to the pooled reaction and mix by pipetting.
Incubate on a Hula mixer for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare 2 mL fresh 80% ethanol in nuclease-free water.
Spin down and pellet on a magnet for 5 minutes; pipette off the supernatant.
Wash beads with 700 µL 80% Ethanol without disturbing the pellet; remove and discard ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash step.
Spin down, place on magnet, pipette off residual ethanol, and dry for ~30 seconds (do not crack).
Resuspend the pellet in 32 µL nuclease-free water by gently flicking.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 37 °C, agitating by flicking for 10 seconds every 2 minutes.
Pellet the beads on a magnetic rack until the eluate is clear and colorless.
Remove and retain 32 µL eluate into a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Quantify 1 µL of eluted sample using a Qubit fluorometer.

steps.title: Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate native adapters to the pooled library.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Native Adapter (NA) and Elution Buffer (EB) at room temperature and place on ice.
Spin down reagent tubes for 5 seconds.

In a 1.5 ml Eppendorf LoBind tube, mix in order (pipette mix 10-20 times between additions): 30 µL Pooled barcoded sample, 5 µL Native Adapter (NA), 10 µL NEBNext Quick Ligation Reaction Buffer (5X), and 5 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase (Total 50 µL).
Mix by gently pipetting and briefly spinning down.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend AMPure XP Beads (AXP) by vortexing.
Add 60 µL (1.2x) AXP beads to the reaction and mix by pipetting.
Incubate on a Hula mixer for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Spin down and pellet on the magnetic rack; pipette off the supernatant.

steps.title: Flow Cell Priming
steps.instruction: Prepare and load the flow cell priming mix.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Flow Cell Flush (FCF), BSA (50 mg/ml), Flow Cell Tether (FCT), Sequencing Buffer (SB), and Library Beads (LIB) at room temperature and place on ice.
Prepare priming mix: 1.170 µL Flow Cell Flush (FCF), 5 µL BSA (50 mg/ml), and 30 µL Flow Cell Tether (FCT) (Total 1.205 µL). Mix by inverting.
Slide the priming port cover of the flow cell clockwise to open.
Set a P1000 pipette to 200 µl, insert tip into priming port, and turn the wheel until the dial shows ~220-240 µl.
Load 800 µL priming mix into the flow cell via the priming port (dial until a small drop is visible on the tip).
Incubate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Library Loading and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare the final library and load it onto the flow cell.

substeps.instruction: Prepare library in a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube: 37.5 µL Sequencing Buffer (SB), 25.5 µL Library Beads (LIB), and 12 µL DNA library (Total 75 µL). Mix Library Beads by pipetting.
Load an additional 200 µL priming mix into the priming port.
Mix the library by gently pipetting and load 75 µL into the flow cell via the SpotON port in a dropwise fashion.
Gently close the SpotON and priming ports.
Place the flow cell into the GridION device and start sequencing.
